title: Outrun the fee drag
intro: A compounding engine where each second is a year — and the fee meter never sleeps.
briefing: Your SIP is running at a 1.5% expense ratio. Watch the gap between the gross and net curves open — that gap is yours, leaking away. Build a ₹95 lakh corpus while keeping the total lost to fees under 8% of the gross. The market rate isn't yours to control in real life; the FEE and the SIP amount are.
debrief: At 1.5% TER the drag crosses 8% within your investing lifetime — the shortfall compounds because the fee cuts your GROWTH RATE, not your balance. Drop to a ~0.5% direct plan and the same SIP clears ₹95L with the drag still under control. And notice the trap: even a low fee drags MORE the longer you run (watch lostPct keep climbing) — which is exactly why fee discipline matters most for the longest-horizon money you have.
